neighbours.label: words marking distinct kinds ('different', 'multiple', 'various'; also 不同的, разного)
fire: The museum's artifacts come from many different archaeological sites.
The syndrome affects multiple tissues derived from the same layer.
Each germ layer becomes a different part of the growing embryo.
The cooks used various spices from several distinct regions.
Patients with this disorder show symptoms of different types.
The survey covered multiple species living in the same reef.
Each team member brought a different skill to the project.
Ancient coins were minted in various cities across the empire.
quiet: The museum's artifacts come from one famous archaeological site.
The syndrome affects the skin derived from the outer layer.
Each germ layer becomes part of the growing embryo eventually.
The cooks used the same spice from a single familiar region.
Patients with this disorder show symptoms of the usual kind.
The survey covered one species living in the shallow reef.
Each team member brought the same skill to the project.
Ancient coins were minted in the capital of the empire.

notes: Card: 不同的, multiple, разного, different, multi among top; no single token dominates.
